lines.en: : Sensei! Sensei! Guess what!
My morning begins the same way as always- with a small girl running up to me and begging for some time alone with my penis.
: Hah...fine. But we can’t do it in the classroom and will have to use my office.
: Office? What? Am I in trouble?
: No. I just got ahead of myself and misinterpreted whatever it is you’re looking for. But go ahead, Miku. I will allow you to talk as an apology for my...incorrectness.
: Why’re you bein’ so weird today?
: It’s my hot boy summer. I’m allowed.
: Well, I’ve got no idea what the heck ya mean by that, but I’ve got some great news!
: Great for me or great for you? Because those are two very different things.
: Both of us!
: Great for me because I won’t be so bored anymore...and great for you since you won’t have to do all of that paperwork you’re always complainin’ about!
: Wait...does that mean-
: Makoto’s waitin’ in the hall right now. Maki drove the two of us to school today after takin’ us out for breakfast.
: She’s finally ready?
: Wanna come see for yourself? Figured you’d wanna talk to her anyway.
: Plus, she’s trying to keep everything lowkey right now- which would give me time to go around and remind everybody not to say anything that might upset her.
: I don’t really want to go out there if she’s not expecting me to come out. The two of us left off in...kind of a weird spot.
: She is expectin’ you, though. And, as her best friend, I can safely say she’d probs be a lot more comfortable comin’ back to class knowin’ you’ll be by her side.
: I haven’t been by her side at all. And while I’m obviously not blaming myself for what happened, I can’t imagine I helped in any way.
: Well, why are you sayin’ all of that to me? Ain’t no way I’m gonna remember it. Just come out in the hallway and tell it to her straight while I work my Miku magic.
So...Makoto is back.
I guess now is as good a time as any with the class suddenly abuzz about Halloween being right around the corner.
But...then again, I worry that might evoke some unhelpful memories for Makoto as I don’t exactly have a history of being “kind” to her on that day.
Maybe I’m looking back on that first Halloween with tinted glasses and Makoto doesn’t feel as broken up about it as I have recently.
But I’ve already decided-
I am going to be better to her.
I’m going to stop pretending I understand what she needs as I’ve been nothing but wrong this whole time and look where that’s gotten us.
And sure, it’s easy to say that now that she’s jumped the biggest hurdle she’ll ever face- but being late is better than never showing up at all.
And sometimes it takes a horrible tragedy for us to find out what’s important.
: Kay! We’re back. Still feelin’ up to the challenge?
: I’ve been away for long enough...the absences are getting hard to justify at this point.
: I’m pretty sure it’s up to me to determine whether or not the absences are justified or not.
: That is most certainly not how it works.
: Either way, if you’re not feeling up to the task-
: I’m fine. Well...I’m not fine. But I’m fine enough to be “up to the task.”
: Or at least partially up to the task. I don’t know. I'm fucking miserable.
: But it’s not going to get any better by sitting in my room all day.
: In fact...heh...I’m not entirely convinced it’s going to get better at all.
: But if coming back is what makes everyone else happy...if coming back can make both my mother and Miku feel more comfortable with the fact that I’m completely fucking broken now-
: Makoto.
: Right...sorry.
: Look after her, okay? I’ll be back in a few minutes.
Miku runs back into the classroom, leaving me alone with Makoto’s body and the seed of grief that has taken root within it.
She looks mostly the same. Her voice is mostly the same- just maybe an octave deeper.
But the way she stares down at the ground when she talks...the way she nervously grips her suspenders and...blinks at an elevated rate as if she’s been stricken with some sort of ocular arrhythmia-
None of that is her.
Or the old her, at least.
I still have to get to know this new one.
But the fact that she’s been reborn gives us another connection...or one more outlet to sink our prongs into so we’re not forced to sink them into each other anymore.
: It’s been rough here without you.
: I imagine the school would be without you as well if it weren’t for Miss Imai stepping up to the plate while I was away.
: Probably. You should be proud knowing that I actually did work a little, though.
: You? Really? You expect me to believe that?
: No. But I expect to prove it to you.
: And that means...what, exactly?
: Makoto Miyamura...you are hereby relieved of your duties as my assistant and are now free to focus on enjoying your high school life.
: Is this you pretending to be nice to me or something?
: I’m not pretending. I really do want to start taking it easy on you.
: By taking away something I actually like doing?
: Do you actually like doing all of that work? Or do you just like being of use to me?
: Both.
: Oh.
: Then, by all means. But this gesture of mine should not go unnoticed since I’ve been actively dreading having to say all of that to you.
: Thank you, Sensei. Though, I’d like to give this “nice” side of yours a little more time to settle in as I have a hard time comprehending exactly what that entails.
: It entails not taking advantage of you anymore, for one.
: Does that include or exclude sexual contact?
: Hopefully, it excludes it. I quite enjoy having sex with you. Which is a thing I probably shouldn’t be saying in the hall during school hours, but hey.
: Daring as ever, I see.
: Says the girl who straight up forced herself on me when I came over to talk to her in her time of need.
: Wha-
: Did that...
: Did that actually happen?...
: It did.
: Oh my god...oh my god oh my god oh my god...
: I...have memories of that but...I could have sworn it was a dream.
: Are you always a rapist in your dreams or did I just get lucky?
: I...am so sorry...oh my god...I don’t even know what to say...
: That was...That was a really weird time for me and-
: Apology accepted. Let’s move on.
: But, Sensei...I did something absolutely unforgivable to you and-
: I said let’s move on.
: To...what exactly?
: To what you’re going to do from here on out, I guess.
: Yeah, you know me- completely immune to anyone overhearing anything that could potentially get me into trouble.
: So, what are you going to do from here on out? Is there anything I can do for you?
: Right now, I...
: I just want to get my attendance back to normal...
: I’m going to apologize to everyone individually for my outburst when I, uhh...pre-emptively came back to class before, but...
: For now, I kind of want to be as invisible as possible.
: Then invisibility it is. Thankfully, I’m pretty sure Miku is in the process of making that dream of yours a reality right now.
: Dream’s already come true, Sensei!
: Makoto, the runway’s all set and you’re cleared for landing. Whenever you’re ready, I mean. Feel free to keep hoverin’ out here with Sensei if ya...I don’t know. I’m fresh outta plane terms.
: Okay...I’ll...I’ll be there in a second.
: You nervous?
: Yeah...because I know what they’re going to think.
: They’re going to pity me...and...and they’re going to feel uncomfortable...
: Probably. But at least you won’t be the only one feeling out of place.
: Even if...Even if I am nervous...and worried...and all sorts of other things...
: I don’t think I’ll...ever feel out of place here.
Makoto shields herself from the unintentionally prying eyes of her classmates by gripping the back of my blazer and slipping into the room right after me.
Then, like second nature, she retreats to her desk and removes a notebook that I assume has been sitting in there since she was called down to the front office.
I wonder what the last thing she wrote is.
I wonder if the page she’s looking at right now has anything written on it at all...or if she’s just trying to make it look like she’s reading so no one bothers her.
As you may have expected, there’s a brief moment of silence as the rest of the girls glance over at her in unison.
But the silence clears up when Miku stares back at them.
And within less than a minute, it’s like nothing ever changed.
But I wonder how those few seconds felt to her.
: Ayane...
: Uta...
: Are you thinking what I’m thinking?
: That four Senseis at once might not be that bad with a good amount of foreplay?
: Nope.
: Wait, what-
: That it’s time to begin preparations for Operation: Phoenix?
: Bingo.
: Just to make sure, though...Operation: Phoenix is code for the second annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars, right?
: Right. Because the first one was Operation: Firestarter and the fire ended when the contest did. And Phoenixes are made of fire or something and then rise from the ashes.
: So obviously, the second annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars have to involve Phoenixes in some way.
: You put a lot of thought into that. I like it. Gives me extra fodder for when I beat your ass again this year.
: Yeah, maybe don’t comment on my virginity this time if we wind up facing off against each other, though.
: Hahah...hah...yeah...
: Facing off against each other in what?
: Is that really the part of Ayane’s last sentence you’re most concerned about?
: Who do you think I am? The boner police? Ayane’s a powerful, independent woman who can have sex with whoever she wants.
: Thanks, Imani. You’re always so uplifting.
: So, this face-off thing...what’s the deal? What’s going on?
: Just some contest thing we had last year where the first floor girls went up against the second floor girls for the grand prize of...Sensei.
: Yo, is that why every single one of you is obsessed with him? The lingering desire to prove your counterparts on the opposing floor wrong?
: No. We just think he’s really hot and caring and a bunch of other good things normal people can’t really see.
: I don’t like anyone. Not me. No siree.
: Oh.
: Well, either way! That sounds fun as Hell and I want in! How are we doing this? Where are we doing this? And, important question, am I allowed to win?
: We do it all over the place! But, for an added layer of fun, we were thinking of combining it with Halloween this year and getting two parties out of the way in one!
: Ahh, yes...Halloween...
: I can finally wear a school uniform without anyone telling me I’m being inappropriate.
: I don’t think you’re allowed to win, though, since you don’t live on either of the floors. But if Sensei is okay with it, you can probably help him judge and-
: SENPAI!
: Ooooh, and Miss Imani Imai gets off to a quick start! Defying all expectations in her rookie season and sprinting across the court to her target!
: But will she be able to land her punches, Uta?! Will the field goal be good?!
: What sport are we even commentating on?!
: SENPAI! SENPAI SENPAI SENPAI!
: Fine. But I’ll tell you the same thing I told Miku. It has to be in my office.
: I ain’t looking for no break time hanky-panky!
: When did all of you start being such buzzkills? This is the worst hot boy summer ever.
: Let me judge the Dorm Wars with you!
: The Dorm Wars? Are we doing that again?
: Either that or I am being hazed and deceived! And I’m pretty sure everybody likes me too much at this point to haze me!
: What if our decision is split and we choose different people?
: Then you and I will argue with each other until one of us changes our mind!
: That sounds unnecessarily complicated for something I could just decide on my own.
: Pweeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeease?
: Why are you talking like that?
: Pwetty pwease? Wit a widdle cherry on top?
: On top of what, you fucking weirdo?
: Damn it, Senpai! It’s no fun if only you have fun!
: I don’t know. That sounds like fun to me.
: If you don’t let me judge this contest with you...then...then...
: I’ll tell everybody what you did to me in the school locker room after swim club practice!
: Gasp. Sensei, how could you? And after I went out of my way to invite you...
: I don’t think that’s a rumor you really want to start, Imani. Some of these girls would rip you to shreds.
: I don’t know. I kind of want Imani to rip me to shreds.
: SEEEEEENPAAAAAIIIIIII!
: Fine, Jesus. But I reserve the right to judge any unofficial bonus contests on my own.
: What’s an unofficial bonus contest? I’m not familiar with this whole process yet.
: Uhh...
: Oh, good. The second period bell. Time to ignore my student teacher and go wander around the hallway.
: Oh, no you don’t! Get back here, grand prize man!
Imani (Who is much faster than me) quickly tracks me down, but stops pressing on the matter of “unofficial bonus contests” when her adult brain sends her a signal as to what that might mean.
I support her decision to slip into blissful ignorance but, despite having agreed to it already, I’m not quite sure how I feel about her decision to join me as a judge.
In an ideal world, she’d team up with all of the other adults I know for a mega three-tiered battle in which they create their own third floor, but...
Actually, that sounds like pure chaos.
The bonus contests would probably be fun, though.
Assuming there...are any of them this year, that is.
But hey, there’s only one way to find out and it sounds like it’s right around the corner at this point.
All that’s left to do is wait and...
Worry about what will happen to me if I am once again split between ten girls crammed into a small room.
Makoto has returned to class!
But she still isn’t ready for things to go back to normal.
What if she never is?
